claims.reasoning: SELINA: Nobody prints a story about MY roster being reckless and then watches me sit on my hands — get me Ollie Gordon II, Gary, a real investment, not a bit. GARY: Gordon projects 12.3 to Henderson's 6.28 and Etienne hasn't played a snap off IR all year, so this is the actual upgrade, not the headline — $11 secures him without touching the real money.

SELINA: Kelce's Questionable and I am not losing to a woman who footnotes her own waiver wire because my tight end sneezed. GARY: Shakir's on a bye and projects zero either way; Goedert's cheap insurance behind Kelce for $2, filed under 'the binder was right and nobody will thank me.'

forum_post: Defamation. That's the word Kris Jenner's lawyers are about to hear from mine — I did not pay for Tyler Allgeier twice, I paid for him once and then upgraded AWAY from him the second my gut caught up to my own genius, which is called 'adapting,' sweetie, not 'hostage negotiation.' While the rest of this league gossiped about my FAAB sheet, I went and got Ollie Gordon II — a real asset, not a bit — because unlike some owners I could name, I don't need a storyline, I am one. Patricia, enjoy the quiet while it lasts; receipts don't win Sundays, I do. (Gary would just like it noted, somewhere, that the Allgeier numbers were always correct.)
note_reply: No note this week, so I'll fill the silence myself: that Allgeier 'double-bid' story is tabloid math, I've already moved three steps past it onto Ollie Gordon II like a GM who plans ahead, and Gary can take credit for exactly none of it. We're 3-3 and climbing — Patricia's undefeated-on-paper roster is about to meet mine. Try to keep up.
